class: A posting's own way in (an email box with a 'Start application' button) was not used once its Apply button was refused
symptom: Color Health on CareerPuck: the posting offered an Apply button and an 'Email address' box with a 'Start application' button. The submission guard refused the Apply click twice (an input was visible, so the page is not a plain posting) and the run stopped with 'final submission is only available through the verified gateway or human handoff' on its first page.
root_cause: The only entry the agent knew on a posting was its Apply button. The guard's structural test lets Apply through only when no input is visible, so a posting that shows an email box beside Apply has no allowed Apply, and nothing tried the site's own Start application control.
why_tests_missed: Posting tests covered Apply links and buttons on pages with no input, and job-alert boxes the agent must not fill. None had an email box that is the application's own entry.
fix: When an Apply press is refused by the guard, and the page shows exactly one visible email box and exactly one button reading 'Start/Begin application', the agent fills the profile email and presses that button. A job-alert box (Subscribe, Submit) never qualifies. submission_guard and safety are unchanged.
prevention: When the site shows more than one way in, a refusal of one should try the others the page itself offers, within the same guard, before handing over.
